description.zh: 筛选条件：发布流程的创建者
description.en: Filters the results by the creator of the pipeline.
The page number. Pages start from 1. The default value is 1.

description.zh: 每页显示的条数，默认为10条，最大100条。
description.en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100.

description.zh:
DataWorks工作空间的ID。您可以登录[DataWorks控制台](https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入工作空间管理页面获取ID。

该参数用来确定本次API调用操作使用的DataWorks工作空间。
description.en:
The ID of the DataWorks workspace. You can obtain this ID from the Workspace Management page in the [DataWorks console](https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console).

This parameter specifies the DataWorks workspace to use for the API call.

description.zh:
筛选条件：发布流程的当前状态

可选值：

- Init 初始化
- Running 运行中
- Success 运行成功
- Fail 运行失败
- Termination 被终止
- Cancel 被取消
description.en:
Filters the results by the current status of the pipeline.

Valid values:

- `Init`: initializing

- `Running`: running

- `Success`: succeeded

- `Fail`: failed

- `Termination`: terminated

- `Cancel`: canceled

descriptions.zh: ><notice>低版本的SDK中可能无该接口，此时请使用ListDeployments接口，参数与该文档一致。></notice>
descriptions.en:
><notice>

Earlier SDK versions may not include this interface. If so, use the ListDeployments interface. It accepts the same parameters.

></notice>
